onInstall.description: Initialize finstack: verify Bun runtime and compile engine binary

steps.name: check-bun
args: command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo '⏳ Installing Bun...' && curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash)

steps.name: build-engine
args: echo '⏳ Building finstack engine...' && bun run build

onUpgrade.description: Rebuild engine if source changed since last version
